02 / Working approach

Clear requirements.
Careful delivery.

Useful software depends on more than the interface. I connect the business context, data rules and technical work, then follow the change through testing and handover.

01 — Understand

Define the problem

Identify the users, the operational need, the data and the limits. Agree what a successful change should do.

02 — Design

Make the rules visible

Map fields and system handoffs. Define validation, exceptions, access dependencies and acceptance criteria.

03 — Build & test

Check the behaviour

Work in controlled stages. Review normal inputs, invalid records and failure paths, with clear evidence of the result.

04 — Handover

Support the next person

Explain how the solution runs, what it assumes and where it stops. Keep operating guidance close to the work.

Quality & documentation

I check technical outputs against source information and business requirements, test the resulting workflows, and document the assumptions and operating limits.

03 / About

Technical depth.
Business context.

My work spans business systems analysis, application development, data automation and practical IT service coordination. I work with users, developers and managed service providers to turn a request into a clear, testable change.

That includes specifications, integration requirements, Excel/VBA workflows, operational reporting, application access and website development. These projects offer a public view of how I think about the work.
